digest.component_or_area: S3 coordinator for non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling)
propositions: Non-create plans must execute atomic postconditions once in dependency order; partial failure preserves earlier success and re-observes only remaining drift within the shared budget.

Endpoint-scoped fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted outcomes across at least two tickets on that endpoint; provider-scoped fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning two or more distinct endpoints of the same provider.

Eligible fuse-incrementing dispositions are exhausted_transient and retryable_deferred (both arising exclusively from RetryBudget caps); excluded outcomes include commit_unknown, recovered, permanent_failure, ticket-local 404, skipped, and non-budget-capped transients.
commit_unknown outcomes are ticket-scoped (never stop sibling tickets or feed the fuse), projected to deferred AC6 bucket (not applied or failed), and replay-forbidden for the pass.
When a fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer with reason/scope/retry_not_before; independent scopes and successful outcomes reset consecutive counters and continue execution.
